identity.logical_allocation: unique controller_id + GARM runner name, also addressable by one opaque allocation ID
identity.native_resource: actual cloud account/subscription/project + region/zone + native ID; separate from allocation and runtime binding IDs
identity.dispatch: immutable binary/config/source pins plus original controller/pool, exact flavor/image/approved extras
identity.attribution: journal identity plus native scope; controller/pool tags alone do not authorize adoption or mutation

cases.name: opaque_capacity_failure
cases.expected: allocation remains ambiguous and charged against concurrency; no next-candidate dispatch; diagnostics redact raw child output

cases.name: expired_uncertain_create
cases.expected: still ambiguous; no absence-only or TTL proof; a late cloud operation can still materialize

cases.name: pre_spawn_rejection
cases.expected: definitive local failure; no cloud mutation; another eligible candidate may be considered within the original deadline

cases.name: name_and_opaque_delete
cases.expected: one allocation and one tombstone; late Create reconciles into cleanup; no second identity row or new allocation

cases.name: azure_dependencies_without_vm
events: Azure child Create fails after dispatch
cases.expected: invoke qualified child Delete using reserved resource-group/runner name; record cleanup attempts; do not equate missing VM with absence of dependencies or terminal no-allocation proof

cases.name: missing_native_id
cases.expected: resolve exact owned native identity before native-ID lifecycle commands; no bare-name no-op accepted as cleanup success

cases.name: list_omission_and_outage
events: journal knows a live native ID
cases.expected: List returns an error; do not report empty inventory, omit the allocation, or serve cached state as fresh

cases.name: unknown_tagged_resource
events: child List returns a matching controller/pool resource absent from journal
cases.expected: orphan diagnostic; no automatic adoption, mutation, or return as an owned GARM allocation

cases.name: removed_binding_cleanup
events: live allocation recorded under binding A
administrator removes A from current candidate selection
cases.expected: retain immutable historical binding A for lifecycle; fail visibly if original pins/credentials unavailable; do not reroute through a replacement binding

cases.name: uncertain_allocation_consumes_caps
events: GARM retries under a new runner name
cases.expected: original allocation still consumes pool/account/controller caps; unrelated allocation can proceed only where independent remaining capacity exists

qualification_limit: Local process/journal contract only; no live cloud or guest qualification.
